example-cards.header: Flat cyclopentane in ligand 3KT of 4r91 entry
example-cards.body: Upon thorough analysis of the cyclopentane dataset, we have discovered that a number of rings seem to have been assigned the flat conformation without adequate proof of the existence of such conformation. An example of a cyclopentane in the flat conformation, which should have a more energetically favourable conformation instead, is the ring in ligand with CCD ID 3KT in PDB entry 4r91.

example-cards.header: Flat cyclohexane in ligand OM3 of 4cfb entry
example-cards.body: Upon analysing cases of cyclohexane rings occurring in the flat conformation in detail, we discovered that most of these rings should be present in one of the more energetically stable conformations. An example of such a potential conformation issue is a ligand with CCD ID OM3 in PDB entry 4cfb.

example-cards.header: Chair-like benzene in ligand 53K of 5mtp entry
example-cards.body: We analysed the 5MTP structure, focusing on ligand 53K, which contains three benzene rings. In all chains, one specific benzene consistently adopts a chair-like conformation, which is unusual for planar aromatic systems. This pattern repeats across the entire structure, suggesting a possible refinement artifact or restraint issue.
